name: Susono (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Susono city emblem in white: an outlined five-pointed star with curved strokes enclosing a swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Susono, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 November 1980; the emblem dates from 18 September 1957.

features.role: Susono city emblem — an outlined five-pointed star with curved strokes enclosing a swirl
